# Reconcile processor payouts before they disappear into the bank feed.

> Free private CSV tool for small businesses to match Stripe, Square, or PayPal payouts to bank deposits and find reconciliation gaps without QuickBooks.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [This workbench vs. Synder](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/payment-reconciliation-workbench/vs-synder.html)
